status: NUMERICAL EVIDENCE ONLY; initial-time Gate D measurements, no complete episode
notes: D0>0 and Dprime0>0 at all tested H, so the first positive episode begins at t=0 and is initially rising for nu=1e-5.
tau_local=D0/Dprime0 is a local diagnostic timescale, not the complete episode duration.
A log-log fit over H=63,126,189,252 gives tau_local approximately H^-2.31; over H=126,189,252 approximately H^-2.34. This is suggestive but not a theorem and not yet H^-5/2.
Complete full spherical Galerkin evolution at cutoff >=4H is computationally large; no BI_H has been measured here.
